articles.summary: OLD GREENWICH, Conn. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 7, 2026-- Ellington Financial Inc. (NYSE: EFC) ("we") today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a monthly dividend of $0.13 per share of common stock, payable on November 30, 2026 to common stockholders of record as of October 30, 2026.
articles.title: Ellington Financial Declares Monthly Common Dividend
